lee: Quick async standup — SDKs / quickstarts / sample apps.
What I did: finished README overhaul for samples/sample-app and added a tiny quickstart script.
Blockers: sample CI failing on mac wheels (M1 builder). Need someone to look at packaging.
Today: will open a small PR for the README and tag for review: https://github.com/redwood/samples/pull/82 :wave:

sam: grabbing the PR now.
What I did: added a packaging test to CI and bumped node-esm docs.
Blockers: mac builder flakes with the test-env container — seen here: https://ci.redwood.internal/12345
Today: try to repro on M1 and review lee's PR.

anya: pushed doc fixes for quickstart steps (typos + curl example). Removed `--unsafe-perm` from install instructions.
Updated: samples/sample-app/README.md and docs/quickstart.md.
CI flagged a lint (md014) for one of the markdown files — will fix trailing whitespace.
Link: https://docs.redwood.ai/quickstart/sample-app

pat: blocker: sample runtime segfault when running `npm run start` in ml-sample on mac.
Short log: "node: fatal error: RangeError: Maximum call stack size exceeded" then process exit.
Anyone on mac M1 want to try locally? @sam maybe your builder sees same pattern.

jen: I can take lee's PR and the md014 lint. Quick suggestion for the curl in README: 
```
curl -sSf https://get.redwood.ai/quickstart | bash
```
Also @anya if you prefer I can strip trailing whitespace in `docs/quickstart.md` and push a tiny commit.

docs-bot: docs-ci: build passed for branch fix/quickstart-typos — 3 warnings, 0 errors.

sam: thanks — starting mac repro now (local M1). @lee I'll review PR later today, ETA ~16:00. If CI green we can merge and cut the sample patch. :thumbsup:

lee: awesome, thanks everyone. If someone reproduces the segfault drop the full log here and I’ll open an issue. I’ll wait for the merge and then do a short release note update.
